rawPayload.Product_Description_Legacy:
24 Inch Electric Dryer with 5.1 Cu. Ft. Capacity
The Logic Vented Dryer focuses on a minimalist appearance with robust and innovative laundry care. The long-lasting stainless steel drum rest on no less than six ball bearings, making the drum and the driving belt run smooth with less noise and an improved lifetime. ASKO dryers are gentler on garments thanks to its Soft Drum™ technology, as they use a one-way tumbling process used in professional dryers. This coupled with the circular indentations with beveled edges also have a cushioning effect that reduces wear and tear on fabrics. With the easy-to-use Lint Trap and the patent-pending Front Filter, you protect the contents of the tumble dryer from lint.
rawPayload.Features_Legacy:
Butterfly Drying System

  • Butterfly drying helps to keep your clothes looking new and fresh by making sure clothing is not rubbing together in the machine.

Favorite Program

  • Save up to four programs to easily access your most used dryer settings.

Delay Start

  • Choose to start the drying cycle at a more convenient time, anywhere from 30 minutes to 4 hours later.

Anti-Crease Mode

  • Select this mode to continue to tumble clothes after the drying cycle is complete.

LCD Display

  • Select the program based on the type and remaining moisture of the laundry you wish to dry.

End Program Signal

  • Audible signal notifies you when the drying cycle is complete.

Other Features

  • Heavy-Duty Construction
  • Stack Kit Included
  • Time Indicators
  • Lockable Control Panel

product.description:
Features:

  • Total 5.1 Cu. Ft. capacity provides ample space to tackle tough laundry loads
  • 13 different dry programs make sure your drying is done right
  • LCD display so you can clearly see what technologies are working
  • Quiet operation only produces 65 dB(A)
  • Heavy-duty steel construction
  • Includes stack kit for stacked installation if preferred over side by side
  • Covered under a 2 year limited manufacturer warranty

Product Technologies:

  • SensiDry™: SensiDry detects the level of moisture in your clothes and automatically turns off the machine when the are dry
  • Butterfly Drying™: Two paddles inside the machine gently push the clothing in a figure eight, to spread the garments out and allow air to evenly circulate through them keeping your clothes looking new and fresh
  • Soft Drum™: Long-lasting stainless steel drum is resting on no less than five ball bearings, making the drum and the driving belt run smooth with less noise and improved life-time
  • Multi-Filter System™: Effectively traps all lint before reaching more sensitive parts of the tumble dryer keeping the drying times shorter and the machine up and running
  • Kid Safe™: Lockable controls

Specifications:

  • Total Capacity: 5.1 Cu. Ft.
  • Number of Cycles: 13
  • Fuel Type: Electric
  • Sensor Dry: Yes
  • Vent Type: 3 Way Venting
  • Reversible Door: Yes
  • Depth: 30-1/4"

  • Width: 23-7/16"
